error.signature: AI tells a foreigner in Norway that holding a D-number and foreign passport automatically qualifies them for standard BankID

verdict.summary: BankID requires an existing bank relationship (bankforhold) in Norway plus identity verification with a passport or Norwegian national ID card. For D-number holders and people with only a foreign passport, bankid.no's own FAQ says eligibility and any alternative authentication method depend on the individual bank, not a guaranteed standard issuance. Opening the underlying bank account, including D-number assignment and identity checks, can itself take several weeks to months, and not all banks offer to request a D-number on the customer's behalf.

dead_ends.action: Assume any foreigner with a D-number and foreign passport can get standard BankID the same way a fødselsnummer holder can
dead_ends.why_fails: bankid.no's own eligibility FAQ requires an existing bank relationship ("bankforhold i Norge") plus identity verification via passport or Norwegian national ID card, and explicitly tells D-number holders and foreign-passport holders to contact their individual bank for available options rather than promising standard BankID issuance.
dead_ends.condition: Foreigner holding a D-number and a foreign (non-Norwegian) passport, no Norwegian national ID card
dead_ends.common_misconception: That BankID works identically for everyone who holds any Norwegian ID number.

dead_ends.action: Tell a newcomer BankID will be issued quickly once they get a D-number
dead_ends.why_fails: Unlock Norway's guide to opening a bank account documents that some banks apply for a D-number on the customer's behalf but not all offer this service, and that the full account-opening and identity-verification process can take several weeks or even months before banking access, including BankID and Vipps, becomes functional.
dead_ends.condition: Newly arrived foreigner without an existing Norwegian bank relationship

workarounds.action: Contact your specific bank directly to ask about BankID or an alternative authentication method for D-number/foreign-passport holders; if the bank can't offer it, use Buypass ID, which provides the same top security level for public services.

Open a Norwegian bank account in person as early as possible, since a functioning bank relationship is a prerequisite for BankID eligibility, and budget several weeks for D-number issuance plus identity verification before banking services are fully usable.

frequently_confused_with.distinction: This canon covers whether a D-number lets you get BankID; the other covers how a D-number itself is obtained (it cannot be self-applied for).
